verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs include a section titled "View and enforce your data quality" plus an "Ensure data quality" entry, which points to first-party schema enforcement. The pack contains only these headings, though, with no detail on how violating events are handled. missing for 10: documented tracking-plan/schema definition, explicit behavior for violating events (flag vs. block vs. quarantine), details on how enforcement protects downstream data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
